#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

bool isPrime(ll n) {
    if (n < 2) return false;
    for (ll i = 2; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

            step1.push_back('.');
            i += 2; // skip 'o' and 't'
        } else {

        }
    }
